newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to consolidate then target 102.10.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to consolidate then target 102.10.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will consolidate around the 101.80s in early trade on Wednesday, before targeting 102.10, technical analysts said.
"There was a strong impulsive move from 101.37 yesterday which signalled further moves to the upside," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch here.
"We'll probably see a bit of consolidation at the 101.80s level, then we're looking to push higher to around 102.10."
Charts show 102.10 was the low on May 15 after the May 14 high of 102.59.

Wilkin said this was also near the 62 percent retracement of the fall from 102.57 on May 16 to 101.37 on May 20. "There will be some resistance at 102.10, but if we do get up through it we could get back towards the recent high at 102.59," said Wilkin.
By 0703 GMT, the June Bund on LIFFE was up 14 basis points at 101.76, off an earlier high of 101.88.

Wilkin said over the short to medium term he expected Bunds to trade between 101.37 to 102.59. "I'm not expecting it to blast straight to new highs yet. We'll probably see some sideways choppy action with 102.10 the mid-point until the daily studies base out," he said.
Support-wise, Wilkin said Tuesday's resistance at 101.68,70 should hold the market with 101.50, 37 providing a further prop.
Geert-Jan Nikken, technical analyst at ABN-AMRO Hoare Govett in Amsterdam, told Reuters Financial Television that Bund prices could steam higher.
He said if the June contract managed to stay above 101.50, the focus would be on 102.05,07, then 102.57,59.
But he said weekly charts looked slightly more dangerous.
